inputs.text: [excited] It was 13 meters long — as long as a school bus! [quickly] Standing up, it was 3.3 meters tall — as tall as two Dads standing on each other's shoulders! And it weighed 7,000 kilos — [amazed] as heavy as an elephant and a rhino put together! [serious] Scientists think it could reach about 31 miles an hour, but only over short distances — as fast as a car in the city.
[confident] Yes. [warmly] But only in short bursts, [serious] it couldn't keep running for long.
